# issue
jira issue list
jira issue list -a me -s "In Progress" --plain
jira issue list "some text" --raw
jira issue ls --csv
jira issues search foo
jira issue view PROJ-1
jira issue view PROJ-1 --comments 5 --plain
jira issue show PROJ-1

# other nouns
jira epic list
jira epic list PROJ-1 --table
jira epics ls
jira sprint list --current
jira sprints lists
jira board list
jira boards ls
jira project list
jira projects list
jira release list
jira releases ls

# top-level commands
jira me
jira version
jira serverinfo
jira systeminfo
jira open PROJ-1
jira open -n PROJ-1
jira browse PROJ-1
jira navigate
jira completion bash

# leading persistent flags
jira --debug issue list
jira --debug=true issue list
jira --debug=false me
jira -p PROJ issue list
jira -pPROJ issue list
jira --project PROJ issue list
jira --project=PROJ issue list
jira --debug -p PROJ sprint list

# persistent flags between noun and verb
jira issue -p PROJ list
jira issue --project=PROJ --debug view PROJ-1

# flags after the verb
jira issue list -p PROJ --debug
jira issue list -C backend -l bug --order-by created --reverse --paginate 0:20

# compound commands where every part is individually safe
jira issue list && jira sprint list
jira issue view PROJ-1 | grep Status
jira issue list --plain > issues.txt
jira issue list && gh pr list
